name: Saikyou no Haramase Onaho Kishi-dan ~Tsuyoi Mesu wa Kyokon ni Katenai! Ero Hidoi Koto o Shite mo Yorokobu Zettai Chuusei Ahe Harem o Kizuke!~
original_name: 最強の孕ませオナホ騎士団 ～強い牝は巨根に勝てない！エロ酷いことをしても悦ぶ絶対忠誠アヘハーレムを築け！～
source:
Fantasy reincarnation! Be the harem king of a bevy of sexy knights. 

You were a virgin until death. 
Reborn as the son of a wealthy family in a parallel world, 
you at first seem doomed to repeat history, living the life of a sexless NEET. 
Money is no concern to you, but reincarnation should be more fun than this! 
Take the wheel of fate and make a hard hentai turn; 
you're surrounded by beautiful chivalrous lady knights. Create your harem! 
Faces will gape. Hips will quiver. You're royalty now, enjoy it! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/announce/=/product_id/RE175775.html]DLsite English[/url]]
